requiredFindings.title: The selected S10 remedy does not cover the new record-bound refusals
requiredFindings.detail: The assertion that the remedy already says to keep the graph within its bounds describes item 14a's summary, not the accepted S10 remedy. Both s10-tsc/reference/native_evidence_model.py:1169 and native_evidence_model.v2.py:1169, and the product REMEDY_TYPESCRIPT_CONFIG_UNRESOLVED at crates/host/src/outcomes.rs:1032, instead explicitly say to keep each file within 64 KiB and the graph within 32 files. A well-typed file with 65 repeated extends entries naming one present base is within both stated bounds, acyclic and otherwise valid, but r10 now refuses it. A 4097-character canonical node path is likewise not addressed by that remedy. The existing alias and D9 row remain correct, but the claim that the public termination remains complete without a successor is unsupported.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Correct the r10 decision table and declared scope to require a narrowly scoped successor of the selected public-remedy authorities and product carrier covering the 64-entry and 4096-character bounds. Preserve the existing public code, aliases and D9 class/code/exit. Name the required successor and its controls, or bind it, under the project's review process; do not claim the old remedy already covers these cases.
